notes:
- Library: presets and playlists on one page, each with Import and Export, Make a copy, and what a preset shows
- Back up everything in one file, screens included, and restore it on this panel or another; the update notice offers a backup before Install
- An import lists what the file holds, so you choose what to take and whether to replace what the panel has
- Power in kW: a value in W or Wh can show in kW, or in kW from 10000 W on
- A legible euro sign, and a Home Assistant value with its name above it stands in the middle of the panel
